ui.footer: These materials were made for our classes.
ui.quizNeedAll: Some questions are not answered yet
ui.binHelp: Tap the cards to switch between 0 and 1. Add up the cards showing 1 to get the decimal number.
ui.txtHelp: Type any characters. Try your name, or letters from your own language.
ui.pxHelp: Tap a square to switch between white and black. Your picture appears as 0s and 1s.
ui.colHelp: Change the strength of red, green and blue (0–255) to change the color.
ui.waveHelp: The gray line is the original sound wave; the orange dots are the measured numbers. Measure more often and you get closer to the original wave.
ui.encHelp: Type a character or tap a button. See how many bytes it takes, and which 0s and 1s, in each encoding.
ui.mojiHelp: Type some text, then choose the encoding it was saved in and the encoding it is read with. What happens when they differ?
ui.mojiCant: "{c}" cannot be saved in this encoding, so it became "?"
ui.photoTitle: Look at the pixels of a photo
ui.photoHelp: Choose a photo or try the sample image. Tap a square to see the numbers for its color. Your photo stays on this screen and is not sent anywhere.
ui.cardHelp: This is a fictional practice race. Which horse do you think will be the favorite? Think about why.
ui.cardNote: Sex/age: 牡 = male, 牝 = female, セ = gelding. The number is the age. All horse and jockey names are fictional.
ui.oddsHelp: Use the sliders to change how much money people bet on each horse to win. The more money a horse gets, the lower its odds and the more popular it becomes.
ui.oddsSum: Total bets {t} × ¥10k × 80% payout rate = {p} × ¥10k for payouts. Odds = money for payouts ÷ money bet on that horse
